root_cause: Unrestricted /ro/:hash/:path* immutable header also matched /ro/manifest.json and overrode no-store. Old browser HTTP cache then mismatched the new bundle expected pack.
fix: Bypass historical cached stable manifest with fetch cache:no-store, keep hashedpayload caching and expectedpack checks
limitations: Actual production verification is signed-out shared AssetPack/demo/PWA startup; owner account and physical Android hardware not accessed
A page already open on the old bundle must reload or close/open once to run the fixed loader
visual_scope: Local recovered-mobile screenshot inspected in full. Hosted tests verify native portraits have nontransparent pixels and capture390x844 evidence; no new artwork or visual layout is changed.
